queries.name: skills Top 10

queries.name: salary GROUP BY
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS job_count, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_min), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_min, CAST(ROUND(AVG(salary_max), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_max, CAST(ROUND(AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0), 0) AS SIGNED) AS average_salary_mid FROM job WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL AND salary_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY job_count DESC, category ASC

explain.Extra: Using where; Using index; Using temporary; Using filesort

    -> Stream results  (cost=5489 rows=6) (actual time=0.961..11.8 rows=6 loops=1)
        -> Group aggregate: avg(((job.salary_min + job.salary_max) / 2.0)), avg(job.salary_max), avg(job.salary_min), count(0)  (cost=5489 rows=6) (actual time=0.958..11.7 rows=6 loops=1)
            -> Filter: ((job.salary_min is not null) and (job.salary_max is not null))  (cost=3093 rows=23953) (actual time=0.0145..5.78 rows=26986 loops=1)
                -> Covering index scan on job using idx_job_category_publish  (cost=3093 rows=29571) (actual time=0.0136..4.15 rows=30000 loops=1)
